settings.heading: Aquatic research systems
settings.text: Six product families, one engineering team. Start with a proven Aquafab platform, configure it to your protocol online, and receive an itemized quote — or order standard items directly.

settings.heading: Find the right system — then build it
settings.lead: Every family has configurable products. Open one, choose your options in the builder, and send it for an itemized quote.

settings.title: Fluid Flow Chambers
settings.text:
Controlled laminar or turbulent flow for behavior, biomechanics, larval dispersal, sediment transport and sensor testing.

  • 1 ft to 50+ ft; cross-sections to 8 × 8 ft
  • 0–300+ cm/s programmable flow
  • Three standard teaching sizes

settings.title: Swim Tunnels & Respirometry
settings.text:
Swim tunnels for fish swimming-performance studies and automated intermittent-flow respirometry.

  • Ucrit, fatigue and endurance protocols
  • Standard: nine sizes from 0.5 L to 100 L
  • Alpha: fully custom, built around your protocol

settings.title: Life Support & Animal Care
settings.text:
Stable water quality for colonies, broodstock and long-term studies.

  • Single, double or multi-rack
  • Mechanical, biological and chemical filtration
  • Live monitoring and automation

settings.title: Aquarium & Habitat Displays
settings.text:
Biome-specific habitats that simulate real environments, built and installed turnkey.

  • Tide pools that follow natural tide cycles
  • Shallow reefs with real breaking waves
  • Public aquarium exhibits, start to finish

settings.title: Software & Control
settings.text:
The software ecosystem that runs every Aquafab system.

  • Trial programming, tidal and thermal cycling
  • Respirometry automation and logging
  • Retrofits and PIV flow calibration

settings.title: Accessories & Components
settings.text:
Extend any Aquafab or third-party system.

  • Thermal, velocity and sensor packages
  • Zebrafish specimen holders, lighting and stands
  • Installation and training
